name: Moses
title: The Lawgiver and Israel's Deliverer
summary: Moses was the greatest prophet in the Old Testament, whom God used to deliver the people of Israel from slavery in Egypt. He received God's law on Mount Sinai and led the people through the wilderness for 40 years. He is a central figure throughout the Bible and is regarded as the author of the five books of Moses.

keyEvents.title: Found in the Basket of Bulrushes
keyEvents.description: As an infant, Moses was placed by his mother in a basket of bulrushes on the Nile to save him from Pharaoh's command to kill all Hebrew male children. Pharaoh's daughter found him and took him as her own son.

keyEvents.title: The Burning Bush
keyEvents.description: God revealed Himself to Moses in a burning bush on Mount Horeb and called him to lead the people of Israel out of Egypt. God revealed His name "I AM WHO I AM" (YHWH).

keyEvents.title: The Ten Plagues and Passover
keyEvents.description: Moses confronted Pharaoh repeatedly, and God sent ten plagues upon Egypt. The final plague, the death of the firstborn son, led Pharaoh to finally let the people of Israel go, and the Passover meal was instituted.

keyEvents.title: The Parting of the Red Sea
keyEvents.description: When the Israelites were trapped between Pharaoh's army and the Red Sea, Moses stretched out his staff, and God parted the sea so that the people could cross on dry ground. The Egyptian army was drowned when the waters returned.

keyEvents.title: The Law Given at Sinai
keyEvents.description: Moses ascended Mount Sinai where he received the Ten Commandments and all of God's law, written on stone tablets. This established the covenant between God and Israel.

keyEvents.title: Moses' Death on Mount Nebo
keyEvents.description: Moses was allowed to see the Promised Land from Mount Nebo in Moab but was not permitted to enter it because of his disobedience at Meribah. He died there, and God Himself buried him. The New Testament mentions that Moses appeared together with Elijah during Jesus' transfiguration on the mountain.
